hammer_conditions.C1: institution + active-year range from the designated citation; no DOI, no coauthors, no ORCID
hammer_conditions.C1x: C1 plus the designated citation's DOI (exploratory); coauthor evidence is never supplied

normalization_rules: doi: trimmed, DOI prefix removed, lower-cased (counts in dataset_quality_report.json)
pid: kept verbatim as a source identifier, never an OpenAlex ID
duplicate DOIs inside one (block, ORCID) group collapsed; DOIs shared by several ORCIDs flagged and their blocks excluded
coauthors: parsed to strip the author's own name and counted; never emitted into any HAMMER context
affiliation: '#TAB#' replaced by a space, whitespace collapsed; originals kept in selected_block_rows.csv

sampling.algorithm: complete-block sampling; eligible blocks ordered by sha256(seed|block) within fixed size strata (unique DOIs: S 0-9, M 10-49, L 50-199, XL 200+); round-robin across strata; a block is taken only if all of its query-eligible groups fit the target; designated citation = minimum sha256(seed|orcid|doi) among citations with an affiliation (else any)
